parsedVerdict.reasoning:
The file passes. SchedulingService belongs to the business layer (a domain layer). It holds scheduling rules: a visit must last 10 to 120 minutes, blocked patients cannot book, minors can only see practitioners who treat them, a practitioner has a daily capacity, slots cannot overlap, and cancellation goes through the entity. That is domain work.

Its constructor takes PatientDao and AppointmentDao from the persistence layer. The layer model lets business depend on persistence, so these are dependency wiring and not misplaced I/O. The file creates no database, HTTP or file client of its own and uses no global accessor.

No declaration uses an HTTP request, response, context, status code or transport error type. The file has no framework decorators or base classes and no ORM mapping. The SchedulingError it throws is a type the project declares in the business layer, so it is not a framework or HTTP error.
